summary: Added `.pi/prompts/` to the workspace prompt discovery roots in the agent server, updated the discover-resources test to assert a `.pi/prompts/continue.md` template is found as a project prompt, and refreshed `docs/resources.md` accordingly. Verified with the agent-server TypeScript check, the 209-test vitest run, Prettier, and `git diff --check`. Then investigated the running live instance to advise the user that a restart is required (the agent server runs straight from source via tsx and has the old module loaded), and recommended `pnpm web:update` because it relaunches through the launcher that carries `GIZMO_WEB_HOSTS`, whereas a bare `web:server restart` would drop those hosts.
decisions: Prepend `join(workspacePath, '.pi', 'prompts')` to the workspace `prompts` roots in `resource-paths.ts` so project-local Pi prompt templates are discovered without copying into `.gizmo/` or `.agents/`.
Leave project-local `.pi/skills/` ignored (only prompts were added).

For the live instance, restart via `pnpm web:update` rather than `pnpm web:server restart`, because the launcher `.gizmo-web/startup.cmd` carries machine-local `GIZMO_WEB_HOSTS` while the bare-script restart path would silently drop them.
No frontend rebuild is needed: only agent-server source was changed and the UI is served from `apps/app/dist`.
For a thread already open at restart time, users should use Settings > Agent > Reload runtime to pick up the new prompt list.
